candidats.description: Charpentier au travail sur le barrage de Douglas, au Tennesee (de l'Autorité de Vallée du Tennessee). Photographie prise en 1942. Cette image documente le travail du charpentier et les techniques de photographie en couleur des années 1940. En particulier, cette photo répond aux canons de son époque, avec une forte saturation. Tiếng Việt: Một người thợ mộc đang làm việc. Ảnh chụp năm 1942 tại Douglas Dam, Tennessee, Mỹ. Português: Fotografia de 1942 de um carpinteiro trabalhando em Douglas Dam, Tennessee. Enciclopédico tanto como um documento de carpintaria durante essa época como um exemplo hi

candidats.titre: File:Drilling rig and a digger at a construction site in Tuntorp.jpg
candidats.description: Epiroc SmartRoc T40 surface drill rig from Vestfold Fjellboring AS, drilling blast holes for dynamite into granite rocks at a construction site for a new house in Tuntorp, Brastad, Lysekil Municipality, Sweden. A Trimble Hitachi Zaxis 224 US LC DMM hydraulic excavator with steel tracks from Scapus AB is moving the broken granite blocks and levelling the ground.

candidats.description: Drill manufactured by Győr-Sopron County Engineering and Precision Mechanics Company /GÉFI/ (Est. 1954) in the tram garage hall building. The building has a history of over 130 years, and its walls hold countless stories from the horse-drawn tram to the modern low-floor CAF units. The depot is primarily home to ČKD– BKV Tatra T5C5K type trams, which serve the tram lines in Buda . Photo taken on the Szépilona tram depot open day 2026-04-18. - 9-11 Budakeszi Road, Szépilona neighbourhood, 2nd district of Budapest .
